# PanDEVbono

> PanDEVbono is a team of developers that designs and builds websites and apps — for the web, mobile (Android, iOS) and desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux) — deploys them on AWS, Google Cloud (GCP) and Cloudflare, and sets up and manages AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and more) for teams. The site is available in Spanish (default) and English.

PanDEVbono es un equipo de desarrolladores que diseña y desarrolla sitios web y apps — para web, móvil (Android, iOS) y escritorio (Windows, macOS, Linux) —, los despliega en AWS, Google Cloud (GCP) y Cloudflare, y configura y gestiona herramientas de IA para equipos.

## Pages

- [Inicio (español)](https://pandevbono.com/): Página principal en español — servicios, apps, gestión de herramientas de IA, stack tecnológico y preguntas frecuentes.
- [Home (English)](https://pandevbono.com/en): English home page — services, apps, AI tools management, tech stack and FAQ.

## Services

- Web development: fast, accessible websites and web apps.
- Mobile & desktop apps: apps for Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux, native or cross-platform. Open to any kind of app.
- Cloud & edge: infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud; Cloudflare for DNS, CDN, Workers and protection.
- AI tools management: choosing, setting up, integrating and managing AI tools — accounts and access, integrations with apps and data (APIs, RAG, agents), usage and security policies, cost and usage control.
- Backend & APIs: services and databases powering websites and apps.
- Design & product: UX/UI design in Figma and Canva; planning and documentation with Plane, Jira and Notion.

## Technology

Hands-on experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Ruby, Java, PHP, React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Firebase, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and Elasticsearch, among others. PanDEVbono is not tied to a specific language or framework: it picks the right stack for each project and can work with any technology a client already uses.
